note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation trophy list. Every guide below is written for this app and cites the source it is based on; where a method is unconfirmed, the guide says so instead of inventing one.

trophies.guide: The last trophy you will earn. Work through the other 54 in any order and the platinum pops the moment the final one lands. PowerPyx and GTABase both put the whole run at roughly 200 hours: 60 to 80 hours of story, about 100 hours of checklist, and a few hours of clean-up.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It unlocks as part of the story, so just play through the intro and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Story only: it pops when the chapter ends. Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house — see Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Story only: it pops when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Story only: it pops when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Story only: it pops when the chapter ends. The optional Chapter 4 mission "That's Where The Money Is…" opens up bank vault robberies — see Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Story only. Once it is done you can keep exploring Leonida freely, and the 100% completion checklist unlocks for the clean-up phase.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list; Push Square

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story only: it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Story only: it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story only: it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story only: it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Story only: it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story only: it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The in-game checklist unlocks after the story, and PowerPyx calls its thresholds lenient — roughly 60% of true completion. Most of it fills in while you chase the other trophies; the checklist asks for more than the trophies in a few places (300 stunts instead of 250, 30 races instead of 20, 70 challenges instead of 50, 15 card sets instead of 3, 8 bank vaults instead of 5), so finish those leftovers after the story and this gold pops.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Any 250 of the 397 stunts in the state count, according to GTABase, and flying under bridges is reported as the fastest kind. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once. One attempt at each is enough — you do not need to win or finish anything. Sample fishing, the shooting range, the arcade, bowling, drone races, meditation, races and the other open-world activities as you meet them.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Learn one range's drills and the rest follow the same pattern — practise each until gold, then move on.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations — 42 races in total, per PowerPyx. You only need one win per location, so pick your best drone and learn each course's lines.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count, on land, sea or air. The 100% checklist asks for 30, so keep racing if you are going for A Long Road.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him — it is a one-off challenge, and the description is the whole requirement.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade machine through to the end of a game — finishing one is enough.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Start Andy's strand as soon as it appears and follow it to its last mission. TechWiser warns that some stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, so do not leave them until after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list; TechWiser, via EGamers

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Start Kenton's strand as soon as it appears and follow it to its last mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Start Billy's strand as soon as it appears and follow it to its last mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. There are more strands than eight, so finish the eight you reach first and take each one to its end. The five stranger-final trophies (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) count toward this one.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Start Randy's strand as soon as it appears and follow it to its last mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Start Tyrone's strand as soon as it appears and follow it to its last mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots according to GTABase (the 100% checklist counts 15, and the two sources disagree, so do all 18 to be safe). Do the first one early: Lucia's meditation on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1 is reported to disappear once that chapter ends, and GTABase and PowerPyx both flag this as the only possibly missable trophy. Meditate whenever you see a spot.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Which animal is still unconfirmed, so follow Bret's strand and take the hunt he offers; the method will be pinned down once players confirm the animal.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; any 3 full sets count. The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so keep collecting after this pops.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Scan 100 different spots with the WAiNK app as you travel — it ticks up naturally if you scan whenever the prompt appears, and the 100% checklist asks for the same 100.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges in total, so any 50 will do — combat, driving, exploration and the rest all count. The 100% checklist asks for 70.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars together, then break out of the red heat zone — both guides point to a train tunnel north of Ambrosia as a good escape route, and bank vault robberies often raise the wanted level for you.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row while still wanted — the jewelry stores in North Vice City sit close together. If it does not pop after the third, GTABase says to rob a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. GTABase says you scan 100 different vehicles with WAiNK — no need to drive them — and scanning traffic near busy roads is the efficient way.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Fill Focus before you start, use an assault rifle, and aim for gang members — cops, soldiers and civilians do not appear to count.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. GTABase's method: steal a docked passenger jet at the airport and fly about 1 km away.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. GTABase's method: steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Open the store's back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code, and clear out the safe without anyone spotting you.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. It needs the optional Chapter 4 mission "That's Where The Money Is…", after which you follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open. Expect 4 stars and have a fast bike ready for the escape. The 100% checklist wants 8 vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck, take its cash, and get clear of the wanted level.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Clear the fog across all 52 areas of the map — flying over the dark patches is reported as the quickest method.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs — GTABase has a gang operations guide if you lose track of which gangs you have hit.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The steps are still unconfirmed — PowerPyx marks this one as not yet known, so treat the description as the clue: find a bar with a view on Ocean Beach and order a cocktail.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. GTABase thinks it means crashing a car out through a showroom window, but that is unconfirmed — try driving a car through the showroom glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. GTAScoop reports it as stealing all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling — that is reported, not confirmed, so go to the alley and look for the valuables.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. GTABase reports it as maxing out Strength for both characters — train strength with Jason and Lucia until both are maxed.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). GTABase links it to the Criminal Profile: 500 actions that change your profile. That number comes from a single source, so treat it as a long grind of choices that shift your profile — and read a Criminal Profile guide first, because the 'Irredeemable' rating is permanent.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The method is unconfirmed — PowerPyx marks it as not yet known. The description suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt; check back once players confirm it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Unconfirmed. GTABase thinks it refers to a strange event somewhere in Leonida — keep an eye out for odd encounters while exploring, and check back once the event is pinned down.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The steps are unconfirmed — the description implies knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. PowerPyx marks it as not yet known.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through fences — GTABase says one fence pays the most, and the total grows during the 100% robberies.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend a total of $100,000 in shops — it adds up naturally across clothes, food and gear, and the money you earn from robberies covers it.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy the 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, around $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register any 10 vehicles you own or find through the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.name: On the Spot
